data_requirements: Official complete starters including emergency activations
Dated individual historical settling position with source publication and capture timestamps
Track going and subsequent official results
Whole-field predictions locked with independent GitHub timestamp before race jump
caveat: Registration is not a genuine forward forecast. Saturday fields must exist and be verified before any forecast.
quality_rule: Do not flip unless >=70% historical 800m settling coverage. Missing evidence keeps exact L5. No result-based horse override.
report_sample_provenance: 91 retrospective races, source limitations documented separately; not a forward test.
